title: Turkish Multimodal Video Fact-Checking: A New Dataset and a Comparison of Zero-Shot Agentic and Fine-Tuned Systems
abstract: arXiv:2611.08651v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Video-based misinformation spreads rapidly on social media, but almost all existing fact-checking systems focus exclusively on English text. Tools for low-resource languages such as Turkish are severely limited. In this work, we present TeViD (Turkish Video Fact-checking Dataset), to the best of our knowledge the first multimodal video fact-checking dataset for Turkish. We compiled the dataset from articles published by Teyit.org, an IFCN-certified organisation, and enriched it with translated Snopes articles and synthetic examples to reduce class imbalance. Building on TeViD, we develop two verification pipelines that share the same open-source base model. translated_title: 土耳其语多模态视频事实核查：新数据集及零样本智能体系统与微调系统的比较
translated_abstract: 基于视频的虚假信息在社交媒体上传播迅速，但几乎所有现有的事实核查系统都仅专注于英文文本，土耳其语等低资源语言的相关工具严重匮乏。在本工作中，我们提出了TeViD（土耳其语视频事实核查数据集），据我们所知，这是首个面向土耳其语的多模态视频事实核查数据集。我们从IFCN认证组织Teyit.org发布的文章中构建了该数据集，并通过翻译的Snopes文章和合成样本对其进行扩充，以缓解类别不平衡问题。基于TeViD，我们开发了两个共享同一开源基础模型的验证流水线。其一为3MFact-TR（流水线1），我们使用Qwen2.5-7B大语言模型和Qwen2-VL-7B视觉语言模型将多角色3MFact框架适配到土耳其语，并加入了三个自研模块：语义不一致性检查器、5W1H问题管理器以及双语证据检索器。
tldr: 该论文发布了首个土耳其语多模态视频事实核查数据集TeViD，并基于同一开源基础模型构建和比较了零样本智能体验证流水线与微调系统两种事实核查方案。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces TeViD, the first multimodal video fact-checking dataset for Turkish, and compares two verification pipelines—a zero-shot agentic system and a fine-tuned model—built on the same open-source base model.
